brand/guidelines-v2/03.png.transcript: What changed since v1. Brand guidelines v2 follow the product as it ships in SpaceWorks 0.12.0. Where v1 and v2 differ, v2 wins. Area v1 said v2 says Decision Typography Gilroy Regular to Bold for everything; Unbounded for accents. Only the free Gilroy weights ship : ExtraBold 800 for display, Light 300 for light display text. Outfit (OFL) for body, labels and controls. Unbounded stays for one phrase. 299 Dark theme Deep Ink and teal as dark surfaces. One solid black neutral family : page #000000 , layers 11, 20, 28. Teal, Citron and Orange are accents only. 225, 316 Logo Static masters only. Same masters. The mark now folds shut and opens on hover and keyboard focus (600 + 1600 ms). Tenant logos never animate. 362 Loading Not covered. One loader everywhere : the box that opens. Cold-start splash, page loader, inline spinner, mono in buttons. 313, 322 Motion Not covered. Three durations, three curves, distance tokens, a which-animation-where table and a reduced-motion floor. 323 Colour roles Seven colours and four tested pairs. Product tokens for both themes: fills vs inks, line vs outline , status softs, scrim, chart series and loader colours. 316, 363 Charts Not covered. Five bright brand colours as series, the same hex in both themes ; a 1 px edge on fills and a 4 px casing under lines carry the contrast. SW-380 Status Add a word or icon. The word is mandatory . Small marks are solid in both themes; large callouts go soft in dark. D6 New sections 17 pages. Logo in motion, theming, charts, mascot Patch, components, UX patterns, product rules, accessibility, ID cards, signage and social. Unchanged: the purpose and personality, the seven brand colours, the logo masters, clear space (H ÷ 4), minimum sizes and the voice.

Splash · once per cold load 1600 ms On a cold page load the box opens, then flies into the header logo. The first screen is never blank. Loader · loops while loading 4400 ms Open, hold, fold shut, repeat. The only loading indicator in the product, from a page down to a button. Hover and focus · once 600 + 1600 ms Point at the mark, or tab to it, and it folds shut and opens back. Every Space Works logo, never a tenant's. brand/guidelines-v2/13.png.transcript: Splash: one opening. Plays once on a cold load, before the app mounts. Flaps open bottom-left, top-left, bottom-right, top-right. Light · on Warm Cream Dark · on #000 Inline, before the app. A generated block in index.html shows it, so a slow first load still shows the brand, then hands off to the header logo. brand/guidelines-v2/14.png.title: Loader: open, hold, fold, repeat.
brand/guidelines-v2/14.png.summary: A 4400 ms cycle for anything that loads for an unknown time. It replaces ring spinners and skeleton shimmer.
brand/guidelines-v2/14.png.transcript: Loader: open, hold, fold, repeat. A 4400 ms cycle for anything that loads for an unknown time. It replaces ring spinners and skeleton shimmer. Open · flap by flap Hold open Fold shut Rest 0 1.4 s 2.8 s 3.7 s 4.4 s Flaps are stepped, never interpolated. Each flap's matrix() is sampled 160 times per cycle and played with steps(1, end) . Browsers glitch when they blend two matrices near edge-on. Colours per theme. Box faces are the masters' own colours. Under-face light, dark; spark / ; the dark seam is the page colour so it vanishes on black. Fixed aspect 136 : 126. Width = height × 136 ÷ 126. The box never changes size while it plays, so nothing around it moves.

brand/guidelines-v2/15.png.title: Hover and focus: fold, then open.
brand/guidelines-v2/15.png.summary: From the resting logo the box folds shut in 600 ms and opens back in 1600 ms. No hold, no snap at either end.
brand/guidelines-v2/15.png.transcript: Hover and focus: fold, then open. From the resting logo the box folds shut in 600 ms and opens back in 1600 ms. No hold, no snap at either end. Fold shut · 600 ms · the loader's fold Open · 1600 ms · the splash opening Starts on pointer-enter of a mouse or pen, or on keyboard :focus-visible . Never on touch: gate on @media (hover: hover) . Always finishes. Leaving mid-way lets it finish; re-entering while it plays does not restart it. It never loops. Reduced motion shows the still mark. The mark never takes focus itself and never changes size. One component ( AnimatedLogoMark ) draws every placement; a guard test fails the build otherwise. Tenant logos never animate.

brand/guidelines-v2/20.png.transcript: From green-black to solid black. Dark was redone three times in one month. Each step fixed a real problem and exposed the next. To 15 Oct Grey-green, then teal-lit panels. Teal text measured about 1.76 : 1 on the lit panel. 10 Nov · decision 225 True black page for OLED, but the layers above it stayed teal-lit. 11 Nov am · 275, 300 Black page with teal-tinted surfaces and borders. Surfaces seamed against the page. 11 Nov · decision 316 · ships One neutral black family. Brand colours become accents only. Token Before (teal-lit) After (solid black) Hex bg 20 44 42 0 0 0 surface 25 57 53 11 11 11 panel 31 67 63 20 20 20 line 77 109 103 44 44 44 outline 147 161 152 120 120 120 muted 199 196 186 172 172 172 accent-ink 171 200 188 128 177 166 accent-soft 26 74 69 18 29 28 Why 01 Two families on one screen fight. Black beside dark green reads as a mistake. 02 Tinted surfaces cost contrast. Teal on a teal-lit panel is dim; on neutral black it reads. 03 Brand colour works as an accent, not a floor. brand/guidelines-v2/21.png.transcript: Fills are not inks. A fill is a background with its own label. An ink is a colour you read. Never use one for the other. Light Issue item on-accent on accent · View public page accent-ink on panel · 2 left ink on Orange · Orange text No on cream · Two label families on-* is fixed. Deep Ink on Citron, Yellow, Sky and Orange; Cream on teal and light danger. Only for text on that tone's solid fill. *-ink follows the theme. For standalone text and for text on a *-soft tint. Mixing the two made Citron pills unreadable in dark once. Dark Issue item same fill, same label · View public page accent-ink on panel · View public page No teal fill as text · Delete danger flips: Ink on soft red · On black Teal as a fill is : 1 on the page and : 1 on a panel. A selected teal fill always carries a label or a second cue. Text, icons and chart marks use accent-ink : teal mixed 50 % with Cream.

brand/guidelines-v2/25.png.title: Two free weights. No exceptions.
brand/guidelines-v2/25.png.summary: Only the free Gilroy weights ship. Everything else is set in Outfit. This replaces the four-weight Gilroy of v1.
brand/guidelines-v2/25.png.transcript: Two free weights. No exceptions. Only the free Gilroy weights ship. Everything else is set in Outfit. This replaces the four-weight Gilroy of v1. Gilroy ExtraBold · 800 · free Ready to make. Gilroy Light · 300 · free Everything in its place. Withdrawn · paid weights, no licence held Regular 400 Medium 500 SemiBold 600 Bold 700 Why Gilroy is a commercial family. Its author releases Light and ExtraBold free, under an EULA that allows websites ( @font-face ), graphics, print and embedding in software. Regular to Bold are paid. The project does not hold that licence, so those files were removed from every repository (decision 299, 11 November 2026) and are never re-added. What fills the gap Outfit (SIL OFL, variable 400–700) takes every role between the two Gilroy weights: body, labels, buttons, table text, numbers and IDs. Unbounded (OFL) keeps its one accent phrase. Never Ask the browser for a Gilroy weight that does not ship. Set font-synthesis: none . Fake a middle weight with a stroke, a shadow or faux bold. Download a paid weight “just for a mock-up”.

brand/guidelines-v2/27.png.transcript: Fallbacks, per platform. Same roles everywhere. Ship the files in fonts/ , and know what shows when a face cannot load. Platform How the faces ship Stack / fallback Watch for Web Self-hosted WOFF2 through tokens/tokens.css ( @font-face , font-display: swap ). Gilroy registered at 300 and 800 only. "Gilroy", sans-serif "Outfit", sans-serif "Unbounded", "Outfit", sans-serif font-synthesis: none so a 600 heading never fakes Gilroy; use Outfit 600 instead. Android Bundle Outfit and Unbounded (OFL) and the two free Gilroy files as font resources; map display 800 / 300, sans 400–700. Missing face: the system sans (Roboto). Never let display fall to a serif. Compose / XML weights must name 300 and 800 for Gilroy; anything else is Outfit. iOS Bundle the same files and register them in the app; Dynamic Type scales the roles, not the families. Missing face: San Francisco (system). Do not let the system substitute a Gilroy weight; request Outfit for 400–700. PDF and print Embed the free Gilroy files where the engine allows. Outfit if it loads, else the system sans stack; logo always as a PNG @2×. Never set the wordmark in live text. Logo Outlined vectors in logo/ : no font needed anywhere. n/a Never retype “space works” in any font. Licences live beside the files: fonts/LICENSES/Gilroy-Free-Font-EULA.txt , OFL-Outfit.txt , OFL-Unbounded.txt . Read the Gilroy EULA before using the face outside a Space Works product; Outfit and Unbounded are free to use anywhere under the OFL.

brand/guidelines-v2/31.png.transcript: Theming rules. What changes between themes is values, artwork and edges. Names, layout and motion stay the same. 01 · One class Dark is html.dark . Every colour is a token redefined under :root.dark . Components read tokens, never hex. 02 · No flash A pre-paint script reads the saved choice before first paint. theme-color is light and dark. 03 · Artwork per theme Logo: full colour on light, reversed Cream on dark. Patch: mascot/dark/ . Box: the .dk drawing. Illustrations ship as twins. 04 · Inks, not fills Coloured text and icons use *-ink . Teal as text on black is , never . 05 · Edges on black Cards and the sidebar get a 1 px line . Anything a person must find (inputs, segmented controls) uses outline , at least 3 : 1. 06 · Layers, not glow Raise by one lightness step: 0, 11, 20, 28. Never skip a step to make something pop, and never add a custom “elevated” grey. 07 · Islands rejoin A Deep Ink panel inside a light page ( .sw-island-dark ) becomes the black family when the page goes dark. No green fields on black. 08 · Scrims and shadows Scrim is Deep Ink in light, black in dark. A dark dialog separates by being a raised panel with a line, not by its shadow. Light Email address outline : 1 on panel Dark Email address outline : 1 on panel Don't Email address line : 1, the field disappears Don't Search a full Citron slab glares on black Checklist for every new page: tokens only · open it in light, dark and system with the OS flipped · themed logo and artwork · no flash on reload · charts use --chart-* · new motion checked in both themes and under reduced motion.

brand/guidelines-v2/32.png.title: Motion shows what changed.
brand/guidelines-v2/32.png.summary: It never decorates. If removing an animation loses no information, keep it short or drop it.
brand/guidelines-v2/32.png.transcript: Motion shows what changed. It never decorates. If removing an animation loses no information, keep it short or drop it. 01 Animate content, not chrome. On a page change only the main area moves; sidebar and top bar stay still. 02 Transform and opacity only. No layout properties. Collapses use grid rows 0fr to 1fr, never height . 03 Enter decelerates, exit accelerates, and exits are shorter than entrances. 04 Nothing on an interaction path runs longer than 240 ms. Longer motion is page- or brand-level and never blocks input. 05 Hover is colour only , 120 ms. No lift, scale or shadow. The Space Works mark is the single exception. 06 One loader: the box that opens. Never loop anything else, except two decorative touches that reduced motion switches off. 07 Reduced motion is a floor, not a flag. Every animation has a still version that carries the same information. 08 No hover animation on touch. Gate on @media (hover: hover) ; keyboard focus still plays. 09 Both themes, every time. Motion is colour-neutral, so it behaves the same in light and dark. 10 Never block navigation on an animation. A slow page settles after 160 ms and the route goes on.

brand/guidelines-v2/33.png.title: Three durations. Three curves.
brand/guidelines-v2/33.png.summary: Tokens in tokens/tokens.css and under motion in tokens.json . Use names, not numbers.
brand/guidelines-v2/33.png.transcript: Three durations. Three curves. Tokens in tokens/tokens.css and under motion in tokens.json . Use names, not numbers. --sw-ease-standard most movement cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) --sw-ease-enter arrivals, decelerate cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) --sw-ease-exit departures, accelerate cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) Durations · interface --sw-dur-fast 120 ms press, hover, exits, menus --sw-dur-base 180 ms overlays, indicators --sw-dur-slow 240 ms route settle, drawers Distances · zero on kiosk, TV and reduced motion --sw-enter-y 8 px arrival rise --sw-pop-scale 0.98 dialog pop --sw-pop-offset 4 px menu drop --sw-slide-x 100 % drawer slide Brand-level motion is longer on purpose and never on the input path: theme reveal 720 ms, splash 1600 ms, mark 2200 ms, loader 4400 ms. Anatomy of a dialog · open, then close Scrim fade · 180 · standard Pop in · 180 · enter Open: focus inside, layer interactive Out · 120 · exit Scrim · 120 Arrives from 0.98 scale and 4 px; leaves faster than it came. While closing it stays mounted but inert, so nothing can focus it.

brand/guidelines-v2/34.png.title: Which animation, where.
brand/guidelines-v2/34.png.summary: When the situation occurs, use the listed default. Don't invent a new animation for a situation that has one.
brand/guidelines-v2/34.png.transcript: Which animation, where. When the situation occurs, use the listed default. Don't invent a new animation for a situation that has one. Situation Use Timing Don't Page or panel loading LogoLoader, 72 px, centred, with a label 4400 ms loop Generic spinner, progress bar Button busy BoxSpinner mono, aria-busy 16–24 px, currentColor Change the button width Route change View Transition on the main area only out 90 ms · in 240 ms + 8 px rise Animate sidebar or top bar Sidebar or tab switch One sliding indicator box 180 ms · standard Repaint each item Dialog · drawer · menu · toast pop · drawer · menu · toast, scrim fades enter 120–240 ms · exit 120–180 ms Unmount without the exit Expand a group Collapse (grid rows) 180 ms open · 120 ms close Animate height List first appears Stagger rise, first eight items 200 ms, 30 ms apart, 6 px Re-run on every refetch Marketing scroll Reveal once on entry 640 ms Replay on scroll back up Hover on anything Colour only 120 ms Translate, scale, lift The Space Works logo AnimatedLogoMark: fold, then open 600 + 1600 ms, once Loop it, animate a tenant logo Success Status toast · verify stamp 180 ms in · stamp 420 ms Confetti in staff or kiosk flows Theme switch Circle reveal from the toggle 720 ms; cross-fade fallback Fade surfaces one by one Kiosk and TV Fades only; slide fade on displays 400 ms Anything that repaints while idle Never animated: layout properties, text swaps in forms, validation errors, focus rings, tables on sort or filter, anything while a person types.

brand/guidelines-v2/35.png.title: Still is a design too.
brand/guidelines-v2/35.png.summary: Reduced motion, touch screens and shared displays each get their own, equally finished version.
brand/guidelines-v2/35.png.transcript: Still is a design too. Reduced motion, touch screens and shared displays each get their own, equally finished version. Reduced motion Loader, splash and mark show the still, open logo. Durations drop to 0, distances to 0; only fades remain. Scroll is instant; View Transitions are skipped. The scroll story becomes a plain page, top to bottom. Patch shows frame one; the 404 “z” stops. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) Touch A tap never starts the mark's hover opening. Hover effects stick on touch, so gate them on (hover: hover) . Pointer-enter from pointerType "touch" is ignored. Keyboard :focus-visible still plays it. Phone sheets rise from the edge they dock to. Applies to the web app on tablets and to the native apps. Kiosk and TV 400 ms fade Shared screens never slide, scale or loop. .sw-kiosk and .sw-tv zero every distance token. Display slides cross-fade once, so a Raspberry Pi stays idle between slides. No confetti, no delight touches in kiosk flows. No mascot loops on shared screens. Distances: 0 px, scale 1, slide 0 %. Every animation in the product (where, why, tokens, trigger, reduced motion, dark): spaceworks-labs.github.io/SpaceWorks-Design-System/motion/principles/ and docs/motion.md .

brand/guidelines-v2/39.png.title: Meet Patch.
brand/guidelines-v2/39.png.summary: A painted wolf with a wrench: the friendly face for empty states and onboarding. The box stays the logo.
brand/guidelines-v2/39.png.transcript: Meet Patch. A painted wolf with a wrench: the friendly face for empty states and onboarding. The box stays the logo. What painted wolves do What it says about Space Works No two coats are alike. Very different makers, all one pack. They vote by sneezing. Enough sneezes and the pack moves. The community decides together. Everyone gets a voice. They look after everyone. Pups eat first; food is brought back to the sick and old. A commons: access for everyone, nobody left behind. They succeed as a team. Collaboration over lone genius. They are endangered. A real story and a cause worth telling. Why “Patch”. The patchwork coat, patching things up, a software patch. Easy to say in any language. Honest detail. Sneeze votes are not equal; say “everyone gets a voice”, not “one dog, one vote”. Anatomy. Huge round ears, kind dark eyes, silver wrench, Maker Teal badge with a Warm Yellow orbit. Never fierce, never mirrored.

brand/guidelines-v2/42.png.title: Patterns that carry over.
brand/guidelines-v2/42.png.summary: What SpaceWorks 0.12.0 settled. Every Space Works app copies these rather than reinventing them.
brand/guidelines-v2/42.png.transcript: Patterns that carry over. What SpaceWorks 0.12.0 settled. Every Space Works app copies these rather than reinventing them. Ask areas, not modules Setup asks which areas a space runs. What is off is hidden everywhere. Never show internal words. Settings by intent Seven groups (Space, People, Areas, Money, Communication, Integrations, Administration), search over all, one line of help per row. Views per role Each area manager sees their whole area; the Space Manager sees it all, grouped by area with totals. Five states, not one Design loading, empty, no results, offline and error-with-retry for every list, in both themes. Shared pager and confirm Every list uses the one pager; every destructive action a real confirm dialog with a close button. Dialogs that stay put Close on the backdrop only if press and release both land there, so a text selection dragged out never closes it. Scroll that remembers Back restores the position; a new page starts at the top. Focus moves only on a real page change. Bulk actions A sticky bar appears with the count and a “Clear selection” action. Search knows synonyms The palette matches both names of a page: Home and dashboard, Notifications and Inbox. Colours that fix themselves A space picks two colours; the product shows where they apply, checks both themes and offers a one-click fix instead of refusing. Simple and advanced Card Studio offers Quick and Advanced modes on the same document, and shows the photo consent notice where the photo is taken. Motion with a fallback A scroll story always has a static version for reduced motion and phones. Layouts, navigation and screen specs, with screenshots in light, dark and phone: spaceworks-labs.github.io/SpaceWorks-Design-System/ux/patterns/

brand/guidelines-v2/43.png.title: Product rules, in short.
brand/guidelines-v2/43.png.summary: What every Space Works product follows, from the main app to the phone apps.
brand/guidelines-v2/43.png.transcript: Product rules, in short. What every Space Works product follows, from the main app to the phone apps. Areas Everything optional is an area with one registry key. Off means gone everywhere. Switching off keeps data; purge is a separate, deliberate step. Role views Permissions are actions, not role names. Each person sees only what their role holds; the server refuses too. One space, one scope Every record belongs to one space and every query is scoped. Public pages never show locations, QR codes or evidence. Audit trail Every state change writes an append-only audit entry. Evidence is immutable. No issue without a scan and a photo. Money Record the debt first, add a payment rail second. Minor units with currency, never floats. Idempotent, and the ledger is permanent. Analytics Counts only: how many, by channel and day, never who. Web, iOS, Android and API clients are tagged. API Every endpoint in OpenAPI with typed errors. The same authority on web and native tokens; 429 with Retry-After. Code size About 200 lines per file, 300 at most. Split by responsibility behind a thin barrel; split first, then add. Install in one line One command asks every question first, changes nothing until you confirm, and runs again to update. Hosted or hybrid One space, many spaces, or a platform. The website can live here or elsewhere with this as the API. Words Every string translated as a whole sentence with real plurals. Error codes stay stable; messages translate. Tests Test what people can observe. The baseline is zero failures, and no test is ever deleted. Install curl -fsSL https://github.com/SpaceWorks-Labs/SpaceWorks/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh

brand/guidelines-v2/44.png.title: The accessibility floor.
brand/guidelines-v2/44.png.summary: Not a target to aim at. The level nothing ships below, in light and dark, with no allow-list.
brand/guidelines-v2/44.png.transcript: The accessibility floor. Not a target to aim at. The level nothing ships below, in light and dark, with no allow-list. 4.5 : 1 Text against every surface it can sit on, including hover and soft fills. 3 : 1 Icons, control edges ( outline ) and focus rings. 44 px Every control's height. One checkbox and radio size. 2 + 2 Focus ring: 2 px wide, 2 px offset, opaque focus token. A word for every status. Colour is never the only cue; charts add a dash per series. No translucent text , and never focus:outline-none . Everything works from the keyboard. The skip link target always renders; collapsed content is unmounted. Accessible names match the visible label. Icon-only buttons are named. Reduced motion is honoured everywhere, with a still version that carries the same information. Loaders speak: role="status" with a polite label; busy buttons set aria-busy ; error toasts are alerts. Both themes are tested: axe in component tests, and a browser suite (WCAG 2.1 AA, light and dark journeys) fails the build on any violation. Tenant colours are proven readable in both themes before they render. Focused button Focused in dark Teal ring on light ( : 1), Citron ring on dark ( : 1).
